newsitem.title: ITALY: Northern League quits Italian commission on reform.
newsitem.headline: Northern League quits Italian commission on reform.

text.p: Italy's separatist Northern League party said on Wednesday that it would pull out of a special parliamentary commission on constitutional reform because the body would not consider its proposals to split the country.
The League has six members on the 70-member commission, which began its work earlier on Wednesday.

A League official said the party decided to withdraw after parliamentary officials ruled inadmissible a League proposal that constitutional reform should include the option of a referendum on whether to break up the country.
The League has declared its own symbolic "independent Republic of Padania" in affluent northern Italy but has little popular support for secession.
